min.description: The minimum value to show on the axis.

max.description: The maximum value to show on the axis.

scale.description:
Specifies whether not to contain zero position of axis compulsively.
Useful when trying to discern small differences in series data.
i.e. If data values are in the range of [9990, 10100].
This configuration item is unavailable when the 'min' and 'max' are set.

decimalPrecision.description:
The decimal precision for values shown on the axis.
Manually added to yAxis in SDLLineBarChart if no decimalPrecision is present.

rotate.description: Rotation degree of axis labels. Rotation degree is from -90 to 90.

nameLocation.description:
Location of the axis name.
'end' is default and is used to render the name at the top.
'middle' is used to render the name at the middle of the axis.

nameRotate.description: Rotation degree of axis title regardless of its location. Rotation degree is from -90 to 90.

nameGap.description: Gap between axis name and axis line.

axisType.description: The type of axis displayed. Value represents a numerical axis for continuous data. Log represents

logBase.description: The Log base for the axis. This value only affects the chart if axisType is log

splitNumber.description: Number of segments that the axis is split into. Note that this number serves only as a recommendation, and the true segments may be adjusted based on readability.

title.description: The title to be displayed for the axis.

hideLabels.description: Whether to hide the axis labels.

percentage.description: Whether to format bin labels as percentage.

onlyRenderMinMaxAxisLabel.description: Whether to only render the min and max value xAxis labels.

title: Type to represent the X-axis config for a {@link UiSdlLineBarChart}.
name: UiSdlHistogramXAxisConfig
